headline: Firefox 157 ships a visual redesign with Compact Mode, new themes
summary: Mozilla released Firefox 157, a visual redesign with bubble-like tabs, a rounded address bar, and refreshed colors and themes across desktop and mobile, restoring Compact Mode and adding a theme picker.

claims.statement: Firefox released a redesign bringing a new visual look across desktop and mobile.

sources.quote: Firefox just got a redesign with round tabs, new themes, and Compact Mode
Mozilla deploys a new-look Firefox across desktop and mobile

claims.statement: The update restores Compact Mode and adds a theme picker.

sources.quote: brings back compact mode and adds a theme picker

claims.statement: The release is identified as Firefox 157.
